ios.desc:
Welcome to The Great Lock-In - your companion for the scientifically-backed 120-day habit formation journey.

Research shows it takes an average of 120 days to form a lasting habit. The Great Lock-In guides you through this transformative journey with powerful tools and daily motivation.

  KEY FEATURES:
  • 120-Day Challenge - Track your progress through the proven habit formation timeline
  • Multiple Habit Tracking - Build several positive habits simultaneously
  • Daily Check-ins - Stay accountable with quick, easy progress updates
  • Smart Reminders - Never miss a day with customizable notifications
  • Beautiful Analytics - Visualize your journey with insightful charts
  • Journal & Reflection - Document your thoughts and breakthroughs
  • Focus Mode - Dedicated sessions for deep work and productivity
  • Dark Mode - Easy on the eyes during evening check-ins
  • Data Export - Keep your progress safe with backup options

  WHY THE GREAT LOCK-IN?
  • Science-Based: Built on research showing 66 days for habit formation
  • Simple Yet Powerful: Clean interface that doesn't overwhelm
  • Privacy First: Your data stays on your device
  • One-Time Purchase: No subscriptions, lifetime access
  • Continuous Updates: Regular improvements and new features

Whether you want to exercise daily, meditate, read more, or build any positive habit, The Great Lock-In provides the structure and motivation you need to succeed.

  Join people who have transformed their lives one day at a time. Your 66-day journey to lasting change starts now!
